summary.intent: Execute and iteratively gap-close GSD phase 68.1 (wiring CipherBox's web app onto the node/v3 read+write chain), spanning an initial 14-plan wave-based execution, two subsequent gap-closure rounds, and live hands-on user verification of bugs (nested folder nav, cold-reload navigation, text-editor decryption, and a GAP-6 product decision to retire dead itemName-backfill code in favor of an encrypted redesign).
summary.outcome: Phase 68.1 went through 3 execution rounds (14 + 8 + 7 plans, 29 total) driving e2e pass rate from 6/208 to ~200/208, with two verification rounds both landing at gaps_found (2/5 then 3/5) — root-caused and fixed write-plane cold-load recovery, durable IPNS TEE-republish enrollment, shared-browser kind discrimination, GAP-1 wrong-key seal bug, breadcrumb-clobbering in dfsFindFolder, and GAP-6 backfill removal; phase remains pending with residual gaps (recovery.html v2-only, rotation-durability SC-4, unconfirmed fresh full-suite run) when the transcript ends.

repo: CipherBox node/v3: SealedChildRef (read plane, keyed by ipnsName) vs WriteChildRef (write plane, keyed by node UUID childId) are distinct; write-body carries recoverable ipnsPrivateKey/writeKey and must be preserved across refreshes, not clobbered by read-only-seeded FolderState entries

TEE republish enrollment requires BOTH encryptedIpnsPrivateKey AND keyEpoch on POST /ipns/publish — createFolder originally omitted these, so subfolder IPNS records were never enrolled and died at TTL/dev-restart

Content encryption has three distinct keys: fileKey (content) vs fileReadKey vs fileWriteKey (68.1-07 split) — client.ts seal sites and downloadFromIpns must not conflate them; resolveFileMetadata expects the FILE's own readKey, not the parent folderKey

mock-ipns-routing (dev delegated-routing mock, :3001) keeps records in an in-memory Map wiped on every restart; do not restart it casually — records only survive via the API's synchronous ipns_records DB-cache write at publish time
API runs on :3000, not :3001 (:3001 is the delegated-routing mock) — probing the wrong port silently tests the mock instead of the real API

docker mock-ipns-routing healthcheck used `wget localhost` which resolves to ::1 under busybox while the app binds IPv4-only, causing perpetual false-unhealthy status — fix is 127.0.0.1 in docker-compose.yml healthcheck

apps/web/public/recovery.html (last touched Phase 24) only accepts legacy v2 single-key vault blobs and v2 metadata schema — the app has produced v3/node-v3 vault blobs since Phase 62, so recovery.spec.ts fails for reasons unrelated to whatever else is being fixed

dfsFindFolder previously unconditionally re-resolved and overwrote every intermediate ancestor's folderTree entry on every call, even already-loaded write-capable ones — this caused breadcrumb-up navigation to flash empty (fixed with a cache short-circuit that still falls through to recovery for read-only-seeded/zero-writeKey entries)

enumerateSharedSubtree (shared-move destination picker) was built on the old share_keys per-child fan-out which the live API never populates — had to be rewritten as a read/write-chain DFS with a new signature (dropped getShareKeysFn/vaultPrivateKey params)

shares.item_name plaintext column was dropped entirely (not renamed) by migration 1750000000000-ApiSchemaCutover, making the REQ-4 itemName backfill permanently dead code — reviving plaintext storage would violate the zero-knowledge rule, so retirement + encrypted-redesign (using pre-existing item_name_encrypted/ECIES pipeline) was the only compliant path
Decision-coverage gate parser requires informational tags placed INSIDE the bold ID group: `- **D-04 [informational]:**`, not after the colon or outside the bold span

code.finding: downloadFromIpns fed the parent folderKey into resolveFileMetadata instead of the file's own readKey (recovered via unsealChildReadKey), causing AEAD decrypt failures surfaced to users as 'Decryption failed' in the text editor — fixed in commit de2807ec8
MAX_RETRIES/RETRY_DELAY_MS bumped from 3/2000ms to 8/3000ms (GAP-2 fix, commit 6185cc443) to give cold-reload IPNS resolution enough time before giving up
hardcoded isFolder = true stub meant the kind cache populated by 68.1-14 was never consulted in the shared browser, so files were always rendered/treated as folders in shared views

workflow: When a background-launched long-running agent (e.g. full e2e suite) parks itself awaiting its own background task notification, its wake-up can be silently dropped — arm an independent disk-based watchdog (e.g. watching .last-run.json mtime) as a backstop, but verify the watchdog actually targets a file the specific playwright config writes, since a mismatched target silently fails to catch the lost wake

Recovering a stalled/evicted subagent: prefer resuming via SendMessage while the transcript is still warm over spawning a fresh continuation agent; fresh continuation is the fallback when the transcript itself is evicted
Verify a git commit failure by checking `git log -1` before assuming it didn't land — 1Password git-sign integration can throw a false-negative timeout even when the commit succeeded

Serial (describe.serial) e2e suites abort at first failure within a spec file — 'N failed' understates true breakage because everything downstream of the failure point never executes; a headed manual run is the only way to see how far a fix actually reaches
Post-merge test gates can be masked by piping through `tail` — always capture and check the real exit code separately
Worktree-isolated subagents must run `pnpm install` and rebuild sdk-core/sdk dists themselves rather than symlinking node_modules from the main tree

Subagents can misreport their own `expected_base` in worktree metadata (reporting their own HEAD/docs-commit instead of the true fork point) — verify via `git merge-base` before recording in the wave manifest

A subagent running a prohibited `git stash` operation (shared refs/stash across worktrees) can silently revert or leak into other work — always audit stash state and recover manually rather than trusting the agent's own stash pop

friction: Wave-1 agent stream stall mid-execution required spot-checking disk state and resuming via SendMessage rather than trusting the stall as a completion signal
Exit-gate agent lost its wake-up after launching the full e2e suite in the background — happened twice across two separate gap rounds, requiring watchdog + manual resume each time

Exit-gate agent hit the account session limit mid-closeout, requiring the orchestrator to manually recover uncommitted diffs, re-fix a flaky test fixture chain three times, and finish the SUMMARY/commit itself
Post-merge gate initially reported false-green because `tail` piping masked the real vitest exit code
git index.lock contention delayed a tracking commit; had to verify via git log rather than assume failure
Decision-coverage gate parser rejected non-standard bullet/tag placement twice before the correct `- **D-04 [informational]:**` syntax was found
A wave-2 exit-gate watchdog polled a file path that this project's specific playwright config never writes, so it failed to detect suite completion — had to be manually diagnosed and stopped

User's live manual testing surfaced three real bugs (cold-reload nav, text-editor decryption, folder-tree navigation post-logout) that the serial e2e suite structurally could not reach due to cascade-abort-on-first-failure, undermining confidence in 'green suite' as a completeness signal
open_items: No fresh full-208-spec e2e artifact confirming WEB-04/SC#5 after the final round-3 fixes (26-29) — suite run was in progress/re-triaged when the transcript ends
recovery.html still only supports legacy v2 vault blobs/metadata — needs its own gap-closure plan to support v3/node-v3 (surfaced during 68.1-25, not fixed)
rotation-durability SC-4 replay simulation reported as architecturally unreachable past the API's DB-cache floor — needs disposition
Commits 17e4319a6/7209e8777 have parens beyond conventional scope in their subjects — flagged to keep out of any PR title
Stray git stash entries and process hygiene issues were manually cleaned up per-incident but no systemic guard was added to prevent recurrence in future worktree agents
